dedupe_keys.name: uniaxial cyclic tests on reinforced concrete members with lap splices

description: Twenty-four concrete members are tested under quasi-static uniaxial cycles; twenty-two contain lap splices and two use continuous reinforcement. Measurements examine splice length, confinement and loading history, including local strains and reinforcement-concrete slip. Geometry, reinforcement layouts and failure observations support modelling of splice-controlled structural response. The dataset is provided by EPFL, Lausanne through BED. BED assigns the experiment to 2018. The provider metadata identifies compressed archives, documentation. Zenodo lists open file access with no stated charge. Actual file retrieval was not tested. BED currently reports that its dataset download was not found; the separate Zenodo metadata is retained. The stated licence is CC BY 4.0. The measurements support calibration or checking of infrastructure response models. Sampling resolution is not established here unless stated above; file-level quality remains unverified. No directly related catalogue record was confirmed.
